steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Records(key_ts TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,id INT64 NOT NULL,value STRING(MAX),resource_version TIMESTAMP OPTIONS(allow_commit_timestamp=true),previous_resource_version TIMESTAMP) PRIMARY KEY(key_ts,id)
